criteria.rationale: The recorded birth date makes the patient 56 on the request date, exceeding the minimum age of 18.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the prescriber plans Wegovy for excess weight.
The July dietitian note documents a reduced-calorie meal plan and walking most days; the August visit says the patient continues the program and plans to continue it with Wegovy.

The June note says the continuing weight-management program began in November 2025, but the July dietitian note says it began in April 2026. Those start dates lead to different conclusions about six months of continuous participation before therapy.
The latest structured BMI is 29.1, and an active dyslipidemia diagnosis satisfies the documented weight-related comorbidity requirement for BMI of at least 27.

review_reasons: Conflicting documented program start dates (November 2025 versus April 2026) prevent confirmation of at least six months of continuous participation before therapy.
parsed.summary: Age, indication, planned diet and activity, and BMI with a qualifying comorbidity meet policy criteria. Human review is needed to resolve conflicting program start dates before the six-month requirement can be determined.
